title: Not worth buying. Huge disappointment.
text:
Not worth buying. Huge disappointment.. This Mandoline Slicer is such a disappointment. I got this mainly for the waffle fries. The blade for the waffle fries is not firm enough to cut the potato. It would bend down where the potato is supposed to slide across. Don’t buy this slicer you will regret it!

The box comes with a mandolin slicer. It comes with a holder that goes under the slicer and there is a basket that can go into the holder. There are several blades and a vegetable holder to help with slicing. Also included is a glove. Instructions are not included so you can guess what the blades are for if you didn’t keep the box.

I will not be recommending this Mandoline Slicer to family and friends, and I will be tossing this thing in the trash as soon as I finish this review.
